info.title: AgentPod fleet list
info.description: The agents a person may dispatch, for SuperPipeline's agent picker on another registrable domain. Written from AgentPod's route on main (apps/hub/src/routes/fleet-dispatchable.ts, mounted ahead of authMiddleware). The answer is read from the verified token's `mayDispatch` claim and from nothing the request carries: each granted principal that resolves to an agent that is not suspended, once each, in the grant's order. Refusals keep RFC 6750's bearer-token shape (ruling 2 of the phase 3 plan), so this document's envelope is the standard oauth-bearer-error.v1: a missing, unaccepted or non-human token is 401 `invalid_token` with an `error_description`, and an organization that has not enabled AgentPod is 403 `product_not_enabled` with `org`, the hub's one plane verifier's answer.

servers.description: An AgentPod hub. SuperPipeline's web app reads PUBLIC_HUB_URL.

get.summary: The agents the caller may dispatch
get.description: An empty list is an ordinary answer: a person with no grant sees an empty picker. A granted id that names nothing, a human, a service or a suspended agent is skipped silently, and the answer carries no field that says so.

401.description: invalid_token: no `Authorization: Bearer`, a token the hub does not accept (unknown, expired, signed by somebody else, or not issued for this hub), or a principal that is not human. One code for all; `error_description` says which in words.

403.description: product_not_enabled: the token's organization has not enabled AgentPod; `org` names it

humanPlaneToken.description: An Organization-plane access token for a human principal, audience the hub: SuperPipeline's web app asks for a hub-audience token for its picker (the issuer contract §3.1). A session cookie is never read. An agent's or a service's token is refused: the authority to ask an agent to work is not the authority to list the fleet.

DispatchableAgent.description: SuperPipeline's picker reads all three. There is no `kind` (every one is an agent) and no suspension (a suspended agent is not listed).
